jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Department Transfer
jokes.joke: I called a repairman about a leak under my sink. He said company rules forbade him from touching it until the water-damage department verified there was water. Three days later, they arrived by canoe. The repairman surveyed my flooded kitchen and said, “Sorry—this is no longer plumbing. You need marine services.”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: The Reckless Repairman
jokes.joke: I hired a repairman to fix my dishwasher, and this guy handled a wrench like he was auditioning for a horror movie. Sparks flying, water everywhere, at one point he just screamed 'IT'S FIGHTING BACK' and stabbed the control panel. I said, 'Do you have a license?' He said, 'I have a temper.' Cleanest dishwasher I've ever owned. Also the scariest thirty minutes of my life.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Hourly Rate
jokes.joke: I just realized the only difference between an emergency plumber and a slasher movie villain is the hourly rate. A stranger pulls up to your house in a windowless van, gets out wearing stained coveralls, grabs a hacksaw, and says, 'I'm gonna need to go down into your basement.' Honestly, the slasher is way less terrifying. At least when he’s done splattering the walls, you aren't out three grand for parts and labor.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Neighborhood Motto
jokes.joke: I grew up in a trailer park, where reckless isn't a phase, it's the official weather forecast. My uncle once decided the fastest way to open a stuck garage was to floor his riding mower straight through the door. Worked great until the mower kept going, took out the barbecue, and ended up in the neighbor's kiddie pool. We still call that Tuesday.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Trailer Park Heroics
jokes.joke: I tried to play hero in my trailer park by fixing my own AC. I marched in with a screwdriver like I was born knowing wires. Ten seconds later it sparked, growled, and I apologized to it like it was a person. I finally told my neighbor, “Good news—I’ve identified the problem. Bad news—I’ve also created two new ones.”
